svg.title: The bus stalls as Babul-da turns his cycle van across the lane.
svg.desc: Water reaches the stalled bus's lower step. Babul-da braces his cycle van sideways across the remaining dry road to stop other vehicles, while Cecil reports rising water despite zero local rainfall.
svg.text: Page 43, panel 3 · Low vertical shot along the stalled bus and rising water

text.tspan: The bus stalls; Babul-da makes his vehicle a barrier

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
